subject: Prorated retention exception and evidence delivery for tenant 'Pinebrook'
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@pinebrookhealth.com>
To: aisha.rahman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary retention extension for tenant logs (SOC 2 / CAIQ evidence)

Hi Aisha,

Quick one from our compliance and audit team: Pinebrook is preparing for a state-level operational review in Q1 and we need to confirm we can retain tenant-level inference and request logs for a single tenant for 180 days instead of the default 90 days while the review is active.

Can Redwood: 
- Confirm whether a tenant-scoped TTL extension to 180 days is achievable for a single customer without affecting other tenants;
- Provide the specific CAIQ/SIG rows and SOC 2 artifacts you would expect to supply as evidence that logs can be retained and then securely deleted; and
- Share an example of the proof-of-delete / export manifest you would provide after a deletion event.

If this requires a contract addendum or security approval, please point us to the correct next step (DocuSign link or PO). We're trying to understand timeline and what evidence Pinebrook will have for auditors.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins
Director, Compliance
Pinebrook Health
[phone redacted]

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@pinebrookhealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary retention extension for tenant logs (SOC 2 / CAIQ evidence)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask. I will loop in our security/compliance team and legal to confirm the operational and contract mechanics. High-level answers up front:

- We do enforce per-tenant TTLs today (default 90d). A scoped extension to 180d for a single tenant is feasible but requires a short addendum so we can document obligations and any billing/SL adjustments.
- We can supply CAIQ answers and SIG rows relevant to data retention, deletion, and logging (rows for E-DS, E-DR, E-SP, and logging controls), plus SOC 2 artifacts: system design descriptions and sample deletion proofs.
- Proof-of-delete typically includes an export manifest, storage object tombstone evidence, and an audit record from the deletion job. I will ask Security for a sanitized sample.

Next steps for me: 1) confirm the exact scope of the retention window (start/end dates/ whether it's a rolling 180d or a timebox for the audit), 2) have Security prepare the evidence packet, and 3) have Legal prepare an addendum template and DocuSign link. Can you confirm whether Pinebrook wants the window to be tenant-rolling (always 180d) or temporary for the audit window only?

I'll follow up once we've scoped internal requirements.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

Summary of ask: tenant-level retention extension to 180d for Pinebrook (audit window). Deliverables requested: CAIQ/SIG rows, SOC 2 artifacts, proof-of-delete example, and process for legal hold.

My quick checklist:
- Retention mechanics: per-tenant TTL tag (retention_ttl_days) already supported in runtime config; requires ops ticket and account flagging.
- Billing/SL: needs product & sales sign-off for prorated billing if extension is continuous.
- Evidence we can provide: retention policy doc, deletion job logs, S3 export manifest, signed attestation template.

Action items for Security/Compliance (Kimberly, Neha): please prepare:
1) short writeup on how TTL is applied and enforced (process + screenshots/CLI examples),
2) sanitized sample of proof-of-delete (manifest + audit record),
3) CAIQ answers and SIG rows for retention/deletion/logging we can provide to customers, and
4) any items that legally require an addendum.

I've attached the internal process doc we use to evaluate retention variance requests.

Marissa

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aisha.rahman@redwood.com
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary retention extension for tenant logs (SOC 2 / CAIQ evidence)

Marissa / Aisha — summarized deliverables and artifacts below. I've attached two sanitized files: an evidence manifest template and the SIG rows we've populated for retention/logging controls.

What we can provide today (sanitized/sample artifacts):
- CAIQ: Completed answers for relevant sections (E-DS, E-DR, E-SP) — see attached SIG workbook (sig_response.xlsx).
- SOC 2: Design descriptions and control narratives for log retention/deletion; we can provide an attestation letter signed by our compliance lead (not the full SOC 2 report).
- Proof-of-delete sample: sample export manifest plus job audit record showing object deletion by object key and KMS key id. We do not provide customer PII in these samples.
- Operational runbook: step-by-step for enabling tenant-scoped TTL, names of services touched, and rollback steps for accidental extension.

Technical notes (short):
- TTL enforcement: retention_ttl_days tag applied at tenant metadata level. Deletion is executed by scheduled delete-worker that reconciles TTL index and issues S3 lifecycle tombstones and records an audit event (job-id + timestamp + admin).
- Legal hold: if Pinebrook requests a legal hold, we can suspend TTL enforcement for the specified tenant via an ops ticket; this is a manual, auditable process and will be visible in our audit logs.
- Export path for artifacts: we can place sanitized exports under a customer-owned S3 presigned link or deliver via our secure transfer bucket (s3://redwood-tenant-exports/pinebrook/2026-10-29/).

Items that require legal/contract work:
- If Pinebrook wants a rolling always-180d tenant TTL (not timeboxed to the audit), our pricing team must review for prorating and potential SLA changes.
- Any immutable/archival obligations longer than 180d require a separate escrow/archival clause.

Attachments included: evidence_manifest.pdf (sanitized sample), sig_response.xlsx (populated rows).

Let me know if you want me to join a call with Pinebrook's compliance team next week. I can walk through the evidence package and the technical runbook.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Lead, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: evidence_manifest.pdf] [Attachment: sig_response.xlsx]

Hi Sarah — thanks for your patience. We confirmed feasibility and have packaged the initial evidence you requested. Summary and next steps below: 

What we're sending now (attached):
- evidence_manifest.pdf — sanitized sample showing the export manifest and deletion audit record;
- sig_response.xlsx — relevant CAIQ/SIG rows filled out for retention & logging;
- retention_variance_process.pdf — internal checklist showing approval flow (previously shared).

Operational options for Pinebrook: 
1) Timeboxed extension (recommended): Redwood will enable a tenant-scoped TTL of 180 days for the audit window. No pricing change. We will revert to 90d after the agreed end date or on request. Requires an ops ticket and a signed attestation (DocuSign).
2) Rolling 180d: Redwood can set the tenant TTL to 180d permanently. This requires a short addendum for billing/SLA and a PO.
3) Legal hold: for evidence preservation we can suspend TTL enforcement until formal release. This is manual and visible in audit logs and requires an ops request.

Ask from Pinebrook: please confirm which option you prefer and provide the desired start/end dates if you want option (1). If you choose (2) we'll escalate to Sales/Finance to finalize pricing and run the addendum.

DocuSign link for the standard retention addendum: https://redwood.app/docusign/RA-RET-ADD-2026 (draft — will populate Pinebrook's company name once you confirm).

If you'd like, Kimberly and I can join a 30-minute walkthrough next week to go over the artifacts and the runbook.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
